description.text: ObjectiveThis program fosters senior engineering and technical talents suiting the world aviation industry development needs, which master aircraft engineering basic theory and knowledge, and can engage in aircraft design, manufacture, maintenance and management. Through studying this major students learn and grasp the following knowledge and ability:1. Comprehensive professional education of aircraft design and maintenance;2. Master the technologies and theory of related fields, including mechanics, materials science, electronics, measurement and control, market economy and other basic knowledge;3. Professional knowledge of broad aircraft design and maintenance and have comprehensive ability and engineering innovation capabilitiesMain Courses Calculus, Physics, Mathematical Analysis, Engineering Mechanics, Aerodynamics, Engineering Thermodynamics, Structural Analysis; ComputerProgramming, Engineering Graphics, Electrical and Electronic, Mechanical Design, Control System Engineering, Engineering Materials; Flight Mechanics, Aviation Engine Theory, Aircraft Manufacture Studies, Aircraft Environmental Control System, Aircraft Maintenance, Aircraft Design, Aircraft Structural Design.Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design.Degree AwardedBachelor Degree of Engineering.

duration.text: The Aeronautical Engineering at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3319 USD/per year ￥ 23900 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Scanned copy of passport front page (and valid Chinavisa page ifyou are already in China)2. Original ornotarized copy of senior high school diplomaApplicants who will graduate in 2025 can providepre-graduation certificate instead.The original ornotarized diploma shall be submitted upon registration.3. Original or notarized copy of transcripts for all thecourses in senior high school4. Two lettersofrecommendation from high schoolteachers, with signature and contact5. Personalstatement (no more than 800 words),includingpersonal introduction,reasons for application andindividual advantages6.Non-Criminal letter7. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form8. Language proficiency certificate9. Chinese-taught programs: HSK4 or above,English-taught program: lELTS (6.0 or above),TOEFL (70or above)or equivalent English proficiency letter.10. Financial Guarantee Letter or bank statementNote: Documents should be in English/Chinese or supplemented by notarized English/Chinese translations. We wil!use these electronic documents to evaluate your application, lf admitted, you will be required to submit final documents while registration on campus.

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens18-25 years oldHigh school graduatesProficient in English
